column3: The Hebrew title is only “Of David”; NASB sets “A Psalm of David” in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “graze on faithfulness” is rendered “cultivate faithfulness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the requests of your heart” is rendered “the desires of your heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “roll your way” is rendered “Commit your way.”
Close to the Hebrew; “be still” is rendered “Rest,” and NASB supplies “wicked” before “schemes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “only to do evil” is rendered “it leads only to evildoing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “abundance of well-being” is rendered “abundant prosperity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “upright of way” is rendered “upright in conduct.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will be satisfied” is rendered “they will have abundance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in smoke” is rendered “like smoke.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for he will fall” is rendered “When he falls.”
Close to the Hebrew; “food” is rendered “bread.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and dwell forever” is rendered “So you will abide forever.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His faithful ones” is rendered “His godly ones.”
